instructions: Start the rice. Cook 1 1/2 cups of basmati rice following the package directions.
Drain and rinse the black chickpeas. Slice the onion, chop the tomato, mince the ginger and garlic, and slice the shallots.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, until soft and pale gold.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Add the turmeric, ground coriander and chili powder. Stir for 30 seconds, then add the tomato and the salt. Cook for 3 minutes, until the tomato breaks down.
Add the chickpeas and 1 cup of water. Cover and simmer on medium-low for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, set a dry skillet over medium-low heat. Add the cardamom, fennel seeds, black pepper, cloves, cinnamon stick and nutmeg, and stir for 1 minute, until they smell toasty.
Add the coconut and 1 sprig of the curry leaves. Stir for 4 minutes, until the coconut is light gold. Transfer everything to a bowl and let it cool for 3 minutes.
Blend the cooled coconut mixture with 1/2 cup of water until it's a smooth paste. If it's too thick to blend, add a spoonful more water.
Stir the paste into the chickpeas. Simmer, uncovered, for 4 minutes, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.

Heat the coconut oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and dried chilies. When the seeds start to sputter, add the shallots and cook for 2 minutes, until golden. Add the other sprig of curry leaves and stir for 10 seconds. Stand back a little. It will spatter.
Pour the hot oil mixture over the curry and cover the pot for 1 minute.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
method_notes: Swasthi's Recipes (5 from 51) leads: onion, ginger, garlic and tomato cooked with the chickpeas, then a paste of dry-roasted coconut with fennel, pepper, cloves, cardamom and cinnamon, and a coconut oil tempering. The lead pressure-cooks soaked dried black chickpeas; this version uses canned ones and 1 cup of water so it fits the time. Regular canned chickpeas work if black ones aren't in the shop. Needs a blender.
